svg.aria-label: Actual federal funds rate and one-month-ahead forecasts. Top: actual rate with Ridge and Random Forest forecasts, March 2017 to August 2026. Bottom: each month's miss for Ridge and for repeating last month's rate. Misses stay near zero except around the March 2020 cut and during the 2022-23 rate increases.
svg.title: Actual federal funds rate and one-month-ahead forecasts
